meaning: reports/release.json production_status and release_ready only say the route passed Synth's router and DRC gates. They are not review sign-off.

routing_and_drc.evidence: DRC: 0 unconnected pads (all 16 nets connected). 35 DRC violations (15 zone clearance, 11 hole clearance, 3 tracks crossing, 2 silk over copper, 4 clearance). All from manual escape segments. Needs cleanup.

rf_review.evidence: 50 ohm feed: 0.145mm trace width computed from 4-layer stackup. Exported as RF50 net class. No independent RF expert review.

usb_si_review.evidence: USB 2.0 Full Speed. Separate ESD protection on D+/D-. No controlled impedance on USB pair.

fabrication_review.evidence: via-in-pad at U1 (aQFN-73) requires resin-filled vias (jlc-filled-via manufacturer). JLCPCB confirmation pending.

component_review.evidence: BME280 substituted for BME680. Balun footprint uses synthesized (original part had non-existent footprint). All parts need independent review.
